brief:
Drop Site News reported that the Knight Foundation awarded a $100,000 emergency grant to Honest Reporting, a pro-Israel advocacy organization known for activities that endangered Palestinian journalists. The funding decision drew scrutiny given the group's documented history of actions critics say put press freedom at risk in the region.

Honest Reporting, which operates as a media monitoring and advocacy entity, has faced accusations of targeting coverage it deems unfavorable to Israel. The Knight Foundation, which typically funds journalism and media initiatives worldwide, has not publicly addressed the concerns raised about the grant recipient's track record regarding journalist safety and press freedom.
dek: Despite a record of endangering Palestinian journalists, Honest Reporting received a $100,000 “emergency grant” from the Knight Foundation.
title: Knight Foundation grants $100,000 to pro-Israel group despite journalist safety record
